_comment: DRAFT reuse gold set (spec §4.3, Phase 3) — 30 hand-checked pairs from the sample corpus (kashshaf-data-clean/data/sample-mini, corpus sample-mini). q is the query span, t the target span; page-local token indices, end exclusive, exactly as Page.tokens indexes them. Conventions: (1) every pair was read on both sides and is genuine textual reuse — a ḥadīth matn, a saying, a Qurʾānic quotation, or an author's own text repeated or restated; shared isnād openings and bare formulae are not pairs; (2) expected_type is the reader's judgement from the texts (verbatim = same wording up to orthography; inflected = same lemmas, different forms or a few substitutions; paraphrase = same content, reworded); (3) zone notes mark spans that are Qurʾān; (4) BIAS: the candidates were discovered with lab-cli reuse-find and then checked, so the set cannot show what Lab misses — add pairs found by other means before treating recall as a measurement. lab-cli reuse-eval reads this file.
